part.text:
## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype in `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` to use full-screen normal page scrolling instead of a modal/iframe container, and align link, button, and option card states with the reference site.

## Important Details
- Generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Quiz styles reside in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css`.
- Must fix bottom "Before continuing" banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container.
- Link states required: default, hover, focus-visible, active (follow repo guideline).
- Button/card states required: default, hover, pressed, focus. Apply once per shared class, never per instance.
- Reference site for states: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Keep changes minimal, do not touch unrelated files, leave no debug code, and do not commit.
- Local testing: `python3 -m http.server 8150`, open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`. Playwright available in `node_modules`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Initial project structure and routing skill files reviewed (`skills/ROUTE.md`, `skills/shared/states.md`).
- Target variant page `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` and source directory `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/` inspected.

### Active
- Investigating quiz layout, iframe/modal logic (`quiz-frame.js`, `quiz-modal.js`), and CSS files to remove modal constraints and implement normal page scrolling.
- Pending CSS updates for links, buttons, and cards to match the 4 required UI states from the reference site.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Read `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, and `quiz-frame.js`/`quiz-modal.js` to identify modal/iframe scroll constraints.
2. Remove inner scroll container and refactor quiz layout to use viewport-level scrolling.
3. Update shared CSS classes for links, buttons, and option cards to implement default, hover, focus, and active/pressed states matching the reference site.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720` and `1024x540`, then provide completion summary.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Target prototype page to modify.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`: Source template for variant generation.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: Build script generating the variant.

- `skills/shared/states.md`: Project guideline for UI state handling.
- Reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html` (state baseline).
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype in `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` to use full-screen normal page scrolling instead of a modal/iframe container, and align link, button, and option card states with the reference site.

## Important Details
- Generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Quiz styles reside in `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css`.
- Must fix bottom "Before continuing" banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; use viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): Define rest, hover, focus, and active states together for each element class before moving to the next to avoid cascading defects.
- Link/button/card states required: default, hover, focus-visible/pressed, active. Apply once per shared class, never per instance.
- Reference site for states: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Keep changes minimal, do not touch unrelated files, leave no debug code, and do not commit.
- Local testing: `python3 -m http.server 8150`, open `/ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Initial project structure, routing skill files, and glob scans of target/source directories reviewed.
- `skills/shared/states.md` read, confirming the mandatory UI state writing order.
- Target variant page `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` opened for analysis.

### Active
- Analyzing `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html` and associated quiz CSS/JS files to locate modal/iframe scroll constraints and current UI state definitions.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move

part.text: How can I help you with this file?

## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype (`variant-a/index.html`) from a modal/iframe container to full-screen native page scrolling.
- Fix the "Before continuing" banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540` viewports.
- Align link, button, and option card UI states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) with the reference site, strictly following `states.md` sequencing.

## Important Details
- Prototype is auto-generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; layout must rely on viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): define rest, hover, focus-visible/pressed, and active states together per shared class before moving to the next element.
- Visual/state reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal diff, no debug code, do not commit, test locally via `python3 -m http.server 8150`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reviewed project structure, routing skills, and UI state guidelines.
- Read and mapped core variant files to identify modal/iframe enforcement points, layout clamping, and dynamic height fitting logic.
- Confirmed directory layout, shared asset paths, and variant generation flow.

### Active
- Preparing CSS/JS modifications to strip iframe height clamping, remove modal overlay/focus-trap constraints, and switch to viewport-level scrolling.
- Planning banner clipping fixes and UI state group implementations.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove modal/iframe constraints, inner scroll rules, and height clamping; switch to natural page flow.
2. Adjust `variant-quiz.js` and `variant-a/index.html` wrapper structure to bypass modal launch behavior while preserving the quiz advancement logic.
3. Implement complete state groups (rest, hover, focus, active) for `.score-button`, links, and option cards per `states.md` order.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720`/`1024x540`, test locally on port `8150`, and output completion summary.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Target prototype page (auto-generated).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary quiz stylesheet containing modal/iframe constraints to be removed.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Figma restyle sheet (fonts, layout, progress bar, answer cards).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Dynamically fits iframe height, advances quiz past entry card, and injects Figma CSS.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`: Handles dialog toggle, focus trapping, and open/close lifecycle (to be bypassed).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: Generator script for variant pages.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Mandatory UI state sequencing guideline.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

part.text:
## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype from a modal/iframe container to full-screen native page scrolling.
- Fix the "Before continuing" banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540` viewports.
- Align link, button, and option card UI states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) with the reference site, strictly following `states.md` sequencing.

## Important Details
- Prototype is auto-generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; layout must rely on viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): define rest, hover, focus-visible/pressed, and active states together per shared class before moving to the next element.
- Visual/state reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal diff, no debug code, do not commit, test locally via `python3 -m http.server 8150`.
- Quiz bundle is minified/byte-frozen; CSS selectors must target existing stable class tokens.
- Variant A currently opens quiz in a modal via hero CTA; registered page does not load variant files.

## Work State
### Completed
- Reviewed project structure, routing skills, and UI state guidelines.
- Read and analyzed core variant files: `quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-modal.js`, `states.md`, and `variant-a/index.html`.
- Mapped modal/iframe constraints, layout clamping rules, dynamic height fitting logic, and focus-trap lifecycle.

### Active
- Preparing CSS/JS modifications to strip iframe height clamping, remove modal overlay/focus-trap constraints, and switch to viewport-level scrolling.
- Planning banner clipping fixes and UI state group implementations.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove modal/iframe constraints, inner scroll rules, and height clamping; switch to natural page flow.
2. Adjust `variant-quiz.js` and `variant-a/index.html` wrapper structure to bypass modal launch behavior while preserving the quiz advancement logic.
3. Implement complete state groups (rest, hover, focus, active) for `.score-button`, links, and option cards per `states.md` order.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720`/`1024x540`, test locally on port `8150`, and output completion summary.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Target prototype page (auto-generated).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary quiz stylesheet containing modal/iframe constraints to be removed.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Figma restyle sheet (fonts, layout, progress bar, answer cards).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Dynamically fits iframe height, advances quiz past entry card, and injects Figma CSS.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`: Handles dialog toggle, focus trapping, and open/close lifecycle (to be bypassed).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: Generator script for variant pages.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Mandatory UI state sequencing guideline.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

part.text: Please let me know what you'd like me to do with these files.

## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype from a modal/iframe container to full-screen native page scrolling.
- Fix the "Before continuing" banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540` viewports.
- Align link, button, and option card UI states (rest, hover, focus-visible, active) with the reference site.

## Important Details
- Prototype is auto-generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; layout must rely on viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): define rest, hover, focus-visible/pressed, and active states together per shared class before moving to the next element.
- Visual/state reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal diff, no debug code, do not commit, test locally via `python3 -m http.server 8150`.
- Quiz bundle is minified/byte-frozen; CSS selectors must target existing stable class tokens.
- Variant A currently opens quiz in a modal via hero CTA; registered page does not load variant files.

## Work State
### Completed
- Read and analyzed core variant files to map current modal/iframe constraints, layout clamping rules, dynamic height fitting logic, and focus-trap lifecycle.
- Reviewed UI state guidelines and project routing structure.

### Active
- Preparing CSS/JS modifications to strip iframe height clamping, remove modal overlay/focus-trap constraints, and switch to viewport-level scrolling.
- Planning banner clipping fixes and UI state group implementations.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove modal/iframe constraints, inner scroll rules, and height clamping; switch to natural page flow.
2. Adjust `variant-quiz.js` and `variant-a/index.html` wrapper structure to bypass modal launch behavior while preserving the quiz advancement logic.
3. Implement complete state groups (rest, hover, focus, active) for `.score-button`, links, and option cards per `states.md` order.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720`/`1024x540`, test locally on port `8150`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Target prototype page (auto-generated).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary quiz stylesheet containing modal/iframe constraints to be removed.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Figma restyle sheet (fonts, layout, progress bar, answer cards).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Dynamically fits iframe height, advances quiz past entry card, and injects Figma CSS.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`: Handles dialog toggle, focus trapping, and open/close lifecycle (to be bypassed).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: Generator script for variant pages.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Mandatory UI state sequencing guideline.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

<content>
1: /* Variant A / B only — advance the embedded quiz past its entry card, and
2:  * (Variant A only) dress the modal iframe to Figma 3776:6405.
3:  *
4:  * Both Figma frames draw the quiz at "Step 1 of 7" (3776:6405 and 3795:3228,
5:  * referencing 3377:75836 step 1), because the page has already asked the visitor
6:  * to take the check: Variant A's secondary CTA says "Take the MTD check" and
7:  * Variant B's intro CTA says "Start the MTD check". The compiled quiz still opens
8:  * on its own entry card, and it has no deep-link support, so the variant pages
9:  * click through it once on load to land on the state the design shows.
10:  *
11:  * Variant A only (the page carries .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a):
12:  *   - inject variant-quiz-figma.css into the modal iframe (fonts, the Figma
13:  *     layout with fluid widths down to laptop viewports, progress bar, answer
14:  *     cards — everything the frozen bundle cannot express from the outside);
15:  *   - fit the iframe height to the quiz's rendered content (the React tree
16:  *     mounts asynchronously, so a static height is always wrong), re-fitting
17:  *     on resize and after webfonts load so the dialog hugs its content;
18:  *   - rewrite the progress fill as a % of the track (the bundle bakes a
19:  *     pixel width per step from the pre-restyle track);
20:  *   - swap the two Q1 card icons for the approved 60px light set;
21:  *   - hide the helper line and the support CTA, which Figma 3776:6405 does not
22:  *     draw.
23:  *
24:  * The registered mtd-income-tax page does not load this file.
25:  */
26: (function () {
27:   var FRAMES = ["mtd-quiz-frame", "mtd-quiz-modal-frame"];
28:   var ENTRY = /start your mtd check/i;
29:   var TRIES = 40; // 250ms apart (~10s) — the vendor bundle mounts asynchronously
30: 
31:   function advance(frame) {
32:     if (frame.dataset.mtdAdvanced === "1") return true;
33:     var doc;
34:     try {
35:       doc = frame.contentDocument;
36:     } catch (error) {
37:       return false; // opaque origin; nothing to drive
38:     }
39:     if (!doc || !doc.body) return false;
40:     var candidates = doc.querySelectorAll("button, a, [role='button']");
41:     for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
42:       var el = candidates[i];
43:       if (ENTRY.test((el.textContent || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim())) {
44:         frame.dataset.mtdAdvanced = "1";
45:         el.click();
46:         return true;
47:       }
48:     }
49:     return false;
50:   }
51: 
52:   /* ── Variant A modal dressing (Figma 3776:6405) ─────────────────────── */
53: 
54:   function isFigmaAModal(frame) {
55:     return (
56:       frame.id === "mtd-quiz-modal-frame" &&
57:       document.querySelector(".mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a")
58:     );
59:   }
60: 
61:   function ensureFigmaCss(frame) {
62:     if (frame.dataset.mtdFigmaCss === "1") return;
63:     var doc;
64:     try {
65:       doc = frame.contentDocument;
66:     } catch (error) {
67:       return;
68:     }
69:     if (!doc || !doc.head) return;
70:     var link = doc.createElement("link");
71:     link.rel = "stylesheet";
72:     link.href = "../variant-quiz-figma.css";
73:     doc.head.appendChild(link);
74:     frame.dataset.mtdFigmaCss = "1";
75:   }
76: 
77:   /* Copy of quiz-frame.js's fitter, pointed at the modal iframe. The quiz's
78:      main is height:auto once the injected CSS has cleared min-height, so
79:      body.scrollHeight is the real content box.
80:      Measure the BODY only, never documentElement: the document element's
81:      scrollHeight is at least the iframe's current client height, so including
82:      it makes the height ratchet — an early tall measurement (before the
83:      injected Figma CSS collapses the layout) locked the frame at ~720px and
84:      left empty black space under the panel that the dialog then hugged. */
85:   function fitModalFrame(frame) {
86:     var doc;
87:     try {
88:       doc = frame.contentDocument;
89:     } catch (error) {
90:       return;
91:     }
92:     if (!doc || !doc.body || !doc.documentElement) return;
93:     var bodyHeight = doc.body.scrollHeight;
94:     var layoutHeight = Math.ceil(doc.body.getBoundingClientRect().height);
95:     var height = Math.max(bodyHeight, layoutHeight, 480);
96:     if (height > 0) frame.style.height = height + "px";
97:   }
98:

 * (Variant A only) dress the modal iframe to Figma 3776:6405.
 *
 * Both Figma frames draw the quiz at "Step 1 of 7" (3776:6405 and 3795:3228,
 * referencing 3377:75836 step 1), because the page has already asked the visitor
 * to take the check: Variant A's secondary CTA says "Take the MTD check" and
 * Variant B's intro CTA says "Start the MTD check". The compiled quiz still opens
 * on its own entry card, and it has no deep-link support, so the variant pages
 * click through it once on load to land on the state the design shows.
 *
 * Variant A only (the page carries .mtd-quiz-modal--figma-a):
 *   - inject variant-quiz-figma.css into the modal iframe (fonts, the Figma
 *     layout with fluid widths down to laptop viewports, progress bar, answer
 *     cards — everything the frozen bundle cannot express from the outside);
 *   - fit the iframe height to the quiz's rendered content (the React tree
 *     mounts asynchronously, so a static height is always wrong), re-fitting
 *     on resize and after webfonts load so the dialog hugs its content;
 *   - rewrite the progress fill as a % of the track (the bundle bakes a
 *     pixel width per step from the pre-restyle track);
 *   - swap the two Q1 card icons for the approved 60px light set;

1: /* Placement variant A: the hero CTA opens the quiz in an accessible dialog.
2:    Focus is trapped while open, Esc closes, and focus returns to the trigger. */
3: (function () {
4:   var modal = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-modal");
5:   if (!modal) return;
6:   /* Look up the hero by its stripe, not by the first h1 in the document: the
7:      page-gate overlay also carries an h1, and at parse time (before unlock)
8:      document.querySelector("h1") finds that one and the trigger lookup fails. */
9:   var hero = document.querySelector(".score-stripe h1");
10:   hero = hero ? hero.closest(".score-stripe") : null;
11:   /* Variant A carries an explicit trigger (the secondary "Take the MTD check"
12:      button); the registered page has none, so it keeps opening from the primary
13:      checkout link exactly as before. */
14:   var trigger = hero
15:     ? hero.querySelector("[data-mtd-quiz-trigger]") ||
16:       hero.querySelector("a.button-checkout")
17:     : null;
18:   if (!trigger) return;
19: 
20:   var closeButtons = modal.querySelectorAll("[data-mtd-modal-close]");
21:   var focusableSelector =
22:     'a[href], button:not([disabled]), iframe, input, select, textarea, [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
23:   var previousFocus = null;
24:   var background = [];
25: 
26:   trigger.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "dialog");
27:   trigger.setAttribute("aria-controls", "mtd-quiz-modal");
28: 
29:   function focusable() {
30:     return Array.prototype.filter.call(
31:       modal.querySelectorAll(focusableSelector),
32:       function (element) {
33:         return element.offsetParent !== null || element === document.activeElement;
34:       }
35:     );
36:   }
37: 
38:   function open(event) {
39:     event.preventDefault();
40:     previousFocus = document.activeElement;
41:     modal.hidden = false;
42:     document.documentElement.style.overflow = "hidden";
43:     background = Array.prototype.filter.call(document.body.children, function (node) {
44:       return node !== modal && node.tagName !== "SCRIPT";
45:     });
46:     background.forEach(function (node) {
47:       if (!node.hasAttribute("inert")) {
48:         node.setAttribute("inert", "");
49:         node.setAttribute("data-mtd-modal-inert", "");
50:       }
51:     });
52:     var first = modal.querySelector(".mtd-quiz-modal-close");
53:     if (first) first.focus();
54:   }
55: 
56:   function close() {
57:     if (modal.hidden) return;
58:     modal.hidden = true;
59:     document.documentElement.style.overflow = "";
60:     background.forEach(function (node) {
61:       if (node.hasAttribute("data-mtd-modal-inert")) {
62:         node.removeAttribute("inert");
63:         node.removeAttribute("data-mtd-modal-inert");
64:       }
65:     });
66:     background = [];
67:     if (previousFocus && previousFocus.focus) previousFocus.focus();
68:   }
69: 
70:   function onKeydown(event) {
71:     if (modal.hidden) return;
72:     if (event.key === "Escape") {
73:       event.preventDefault();
74:       close();
75:       return;
76:     }
77:     if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
78:     var items = focusable();
79:     if (!items.length) return;
80:     var first = items[0];
81:     var last = items[items.length - 1];
82:     if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
83:       event.preventDefault();
84:       last.focus();
85:     } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
86:       event.preventDefault();
87:       first.focus();
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   function guardFocus(event) {
92:     if (modal.hidden || modal.contains(event.target)) return;
93:     var first = modal.querySelector(".mtd-quiz-modal-close");
94:     if (first) first.focus();
95:   }
96: 
97:   function forwardEscape(event) {
98:     if (event.key === "Escape") {
99:       event.preventDefault();
100:       close();
101:     }
102:   }
103: 
104:   var frame = document.getElementById("mtd-quiz-modal-frame");
105:   if (frame) {
106:     frame.addEventListener("load", function () {
107:       try {
108:         frame.contentWindow.addEventListener("keydown", forwardEscape);
109:       } catch (error) {
110:         /* file:// opaque origin */
111:       }
112:     });
113:   }
114: 
115:   trigger.addEventListener("click", open);
116:   Array.prototype.forEach.call(closeButtons, function (button) {
117:     button.addEventListener("click", close);
118:   });
119:   document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeydown);
120:   document.addEventListener("focusin", guardFocus);
121: })();

## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype from a modal/iframe container to full-screen native page scrolling.
- Fix the "Before continuing" banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540` viewports, and align link, button, and option card UI states with the reference site.

## Important Details
- Prototype is auto-generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; layout must rely on viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): define rest, hover, focus-visible/pressed, and active states together per shared class before moving to the next element.
- Visual/state reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal diff, no debug code, do not commit, test locally via `python3 -m http.server 8150`.
- Quiz bundle is minified/byte-frozen; CSS selectors must target existing stable class tokens.
- Variant A currently opens quiz in a modal via hero CTA; registered page does not load variant files.
- Workflow governed by `skills/ROUTE.md` (run `node` commands when specified, open named skills for pattern work, otherwise stop and ask).

## Work State
### Completed
- Read and analyzed core variant files (`quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `quiz-modal.js`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `variant-a/index.html`) to map current modal/iframe constraints, layout clamping rules, dynamic height fitting logic, and focus-trap lifecycle.
- Reviewed `skills/ROUTE.md` and `skills/shared/states.md` to confirm routing logic and mandatory UI state sequencing guidelines.

### Active
- Preparing CSS/JS modifications to strip iframe height clamping, remove modal overlay/focus-trap constraints, and switch to viewport-level scrolling.
- Planning banner clipping fixes and complete UI state group implementations.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove modal/iframe constraints, inner scroll rules, and height clamping; switch to natural page flow.
2. Adjust `variant-quiz.js` and `variant-a/index.html` wrapper structure to bypass modal launch behavior while preserving the quiz advancement logic.
3. Implement complete state groups (rest, hover, focus, active) for `.score-button`, links, and option cards per `states.md` order.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720`/`1024x540`, test locally on port `8150`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`: Target prototype page (auto-generated).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`: Primary quiz stylesheet containing modal/iframe constraints to be removed.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`: Figma restyle sheet (fonts, layout, progress bar, answer cards).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`: Dynamically fits iframe height, advances quiz past entry card, and injects Figma CSS.
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`: Handles dialog toggle, focus trapping, and open/close lifecycle (to be bypassed).
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`: Generator script for variant pages.
- `skills/shared/states.md`: Mandatory UI state sequencing guideline.
- `skills/ROUTE.md`: Project routing and skill invocation rules.
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

Product UI as HTML from a node inside a component set: `figma-shot.js` cannot export there (the transport append is rejected) — measure live `get_design_context` geometry instead of the SVG pattern.

Product UI as HTML for a tab pane's picture: a raster pane inside a PNGs-only pattern takes live HTML only as a recorded deviation (the hero media-slot precedent — no SVG either way), and its 2x measure comes from `download_assets --defaultScale 2`; `get_screenshot` answers 1x for that vector node whatever `maxDimension` says, so sizing off it reads every small role a size short. A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. A chart whose height is paid twice breaks the frame first: the 1.2× pie that fitted one aged card was a 508 canvas once the two were stacked, and a 137 donut was a 533 canvas at every width past 730 while every gate the page had still passed (2026-10-17).

Product UI as HTML, ruled cuts: scope cuts by media × container (`@media (max-width: 1079px) { @container (max-width: 559px) { … } }`) — a slot-width-only cut list fires on 1180–1420 laptop slots and hides card titles on desktops; pin the ruled height in the media block, never inside the pane's own `@container` (dead CSS — computed `0px` everywhere), and gate `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at phone widths (an art with a nowrap title needs `container-type: inline-size` to follow its slot; `min-width: 0` does not lower an intrinsic contribution).

Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. A missing column is a migration — sweep it per `docs/SUPABASE-APPLY.md`, and a re-run of one must be a no-op: a `create policy` without its own `drop policy if exists` aborts the whole Studio batch (42710) — `20261014130000` carried one until 2026-10-16. Paste-success is the editor's opinion; the deployed page's console going quiet is the after-apply proof, and it is scripted now: `node tooling/verify-live-doors.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-responsive.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-cpp-paths.js`, plus the write path's `node tooling/verify-write-roundtrip.js` (refused → stamped → resolved → deleted, nothing left behind). A code changed in one place drifts the others. A tool the docs name is not evidence it runs: `add-pair.js` still rewrote a source array two weeks after the pairs moved into `quick_signin_accounts` (fixed 2026-10-16); it needs the service key and is the only thing that also moves the bot's auth password. A tool that measures the deployed page needs both doors: `audit-live-comments.js` carries the passcode cookie and a @sage.com stub session — without them it measures the sign-in shell and times out, which is exactly what the server door (2026-10-15) did to it for a day. A sweep must not reset a pair: the seeds insert only when the row is absent and self-test against the code the row holds — `do update set code` drove a rotated code back to the committed default on every re-run (fixed 2026-10-16).

A deployed old-tree folder URL 404s while its no-slash sibling redirects: trailing-slash normalisation runs before the redirect rules, so `:path*` never matches a URL that ends in a slash. The fix is the explicit rule pair plus the `middleware.js` backstop, not a wider wildcard. A case mismatch between macOS and Linux (e.g. Ongoing_project vs ongoing_project from .gitignore) 404s all child pages on Vercel: keep .gitignore rules lowercase and resolve casing dynamically in `middleware.js`.

A canvas added to a hub or guidelines page needs the page's UI floor — `overflow-x: auto` on the canvas and `min-width: 360px` on the art — or it grows past the 500 frame below a 360 viewport: four canvases measured 562 and the §4 template 525.7 while §1 stated 500 as a rule (2026-10-17). `node tooling/floor-check.js` walks every canvas on the page at 29 widths, so the claim is checked rather than asserted.

Hub or guidelines page: zero `figure` margins in the demo art (the UA default 40px sides force the page wide at phone widths) and `min-width: 0` on flex frames (a nowrap row pins the frame to its min-content otherwise). Borders wrap the body below the header only — chrome and header never carry one. Icons come from `icons/ui-icons` verbatim (here `chevron-down`), sized width = height — never a text glyph, never redrawn.

One component, many markets: two hand-harvested copies of the same `score-*` macro drifted because §0 sat outside `sync-check.js` — market copy belongs in `components/site-header/nav.matrix.json` and a page's own self-link in that page's `nav.overrides.json`, never in the markup. A market or product with no captured live page stays `enabled:false` with a note: panels that were never harvested ship the back-button shell, and the validator refuses to invent copy. The identity preset proves the renderer byte-for-byte (`render.js --check`), and a nav change is not verified until `check-nav.js` is green for all three pages. The Figma half is `components/site-header/navigation/build-matrix.js`: one frame per preset, combined into the `Sage nav` set with `Market`/`Product` variant properties, and the set id changes on every `--all` because the frames are rebuilt. A two-slot text **swap is unreachable** in the kit — every write re-resolves its target by master text, so after `Shop="Blog"` the string `Blog` matches two nodes and the next write lands on the one just written (it rendered `Support, Blog` twice). Hide the slot and write the other two on their own slots instead of swapping.

A glyph inside a picture of product UI is not a site icon: no `icons/ui-icons` / `icons/detailed-icons` master, a recorded gap, and a redraw at the size it ships — a 24 box shown at 10 px needs ≥2 px of ink and only its silhouette survives (`skills/shared/iconography.md` § *A glyph inside a picture of product UI*; the reference is evidence, never copy the year it was screenshotted — `product-ui/guidelines.md` §7, gated by `tooling/check-s50cs-art.js`).

Product UI as HTML into a file path: measure the host ancestors' boxes before editing; a wrapper with `overflow:hidden` clips below content, and element screenshots never catch it.

Product UI as HTML from a node inside a component set: `figma-shot.js` cannot export there (the transport append is rejected) — measure live `get_design_context` geometry instead of the SVG pattern.

Product UI as HTML for a tab pane's picture: a raster pane inside a PNGs-only pattern takes live HTML only as a recorded deviation (the hero media-slot precedent — no SVG either way), and its 2x measure comes from `download_assets --defaultScale 2`; `get_screenshot` answers 1x for that vector node whatever `maxDimension` says, so sizing off it reads every small role a size short. A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. A chart whose height is paid twice breaks the frame first: the 1.2× pie that fitted one aged card was a 508 canvas once the two were stacked, and a 137 donut was a 533 canvas at every width past 730 while every gate the page had still passed (2026-10-17).

Product UI as HTML, ruled cuts: scope cuts by media × container (`@media (max-width: 1079px) { @container (max-width: 559px) { … } }`) — a slot-width-only cut list fires on 1180–1420 laptop slots and hides card titles on desktops; pin the ruled height in the media block, never inside the pane's own `@container` (dead CSS — computed `0px` everywhere), and gate `scrollWidth == clientWidth` at phone widths (an art with a nowrap title needs `container-type: inline-size` to follow its slot; `min-width: 0` does not lower an intrinsic contribution).

Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. A missing column is a migration — sweep it per `docs/SUPABASE-APPLY.md`, and a re-run of one must be a no-op: a `create policy` without its own `drop policy if exists` aborts the whole Studio batch (42710) — `20261014130000` carried one until 2026-10-16. Paste-success is the editor's opinion; the deployed page's console going quiet is the after-apply proof, and it is scripted now: `node tooling/verify-live-doors.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-responsive.js`, `node tooling/verify-live-cpp-paths.js`, plus the write path's `node tooling/verify-write-roundtrip.js` (refused → stamped → resolved → deleted, nothing left behind). A live gate aimed at the page the change did not touch is not evidence about the page that shipped: `verify-live-responsive.js` opened only the unchanged vendor page and passed 12/12 while customer-payment-services scrolled sideways at 390px — it walks both CPP pages now, and a gated page hides its panes, so `render-check.js` strips the lock the way `check-tab-email.js` does. A migration cannot enable a dashboard hook: applying `15120000`'s function changes nothing until Authentication → Hooks → Before user created points at it — enable it (2026-10-16) and prove it with a real non-Sage sign-up, which must return `403` before any account exists (`node tooling/verify-signup-hook.js`). `node tooling/verify-page-comments.js` never loads `main.css`. A brand mark is already exported. Copy `icons/logos/sage.svg` onto the global bar and `icons/product-identifiers/sage-intacct--dark.svg` onto the dark sticky bar. Do not redraw either file.

The gate's viewing passcode and bot id are rows in `quick_signin_accounts`, never code: `resolve_pair()` is the one oracle the gate, `middleware.js` and the panel share, and the panel's Access section is the editor. A code changed in one place drifts the others. A tool the docs name is not evidence it runs: `add-pair.js` still rewrote a source array two weeks after the pairs moved into `quick_signin_accounts` (fixed 2026-10-16); it needs the service key and is the only thing that also moves the bot's auth password. A tool that measures the deployed page needs both doors: `audit-live-comments.js` carries the passcode cookie and a @sage.com stub session — without them it measures the sign-in shell and times out, which is exactly what the server door (2026-10-15) did to it for a day. A sweep must not reset a pair: the seeds insert only when the row is absent and self-test against the code the row holds — `do update set code` drove a rotated code back to the committed default on every re-run (fixed 2026-10-16).

A deployed old-tree folder URL 404s while its no-slash sibling redirects: trailing-slash normalisation runs before the redirect rules, so `:path*` never matches a URL that ends in a slash. The fix is the explicit rule pair plus the `middleware.js` backstop, not a wider wildcard. A case mismatch between macOS and Linux (e.g. Ongoing_project vs ongoing_project from .gitignore) 404s all child pages on Vercel: keep .gitignore rules lowercase and resolve casing dynamically in `middleware.js`.

A red `node tooling/build-node-index.js --check` is not cleared by regenerating. The parser reads the cpp block and the first table in `ongoing_project/cpp/MAP.md`.

`skills/figma-mcp-connect/SKILL.md` opens only when the Figma call fails to authenticate.

Product UI as HTML for a tab pane's picture: a raster pane inside a PNGs-only pattern takes live HTML only as a recorded deviation (the hero media-slot precedent — no SVG either way), and its 2x measure comes from `download_assets --defaultScale 2`; `get_screenshot` answers 1x for that vector node whatever `maxDimension` says, so sizing off it reads every small role a size short. A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype from a modal/iframe container to full-screen native page scrolling, fixing banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540`, and aligning link/button/card UI states with the reference site.

## Important Details
- Prototype is auto-generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; layout must rely on viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): define rest, hover, focus-visible/pressed, and active states together per shared class before editing the next element.
- Visual/state reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal diff, no debug code, do not commit, test locally via `python3 -m http.server 8150`.
- Quiz bundle is minified/byte-frozen; CSS selectors must target existing stable class tokens.
- Variant A currently opens quiz in a modal via hero CTA; registered page does not load variant files.
- Workflow governed by `skills/ROUTE.md`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Read and analyzed core variant files (`quiz-page.css`, `variant-quiz.js`, `variant-quiz-figma.css`, `quiz-modal.js`, `variant-a/index.html`) to map current modal/iframe constraints, layout clamping, dynamic height fitting, and focus-trap lifecycle.
- Reviewed routing (`skills/ROUTE.md`) and state sequencing guidelines (`skills/shared/states.md`).

### Active
- Preparing CSS/JS modifications to strip iframe height clamping, remove modal overlay/focus-trap constraints, and switch to viewport-level scrolling.
- Planning banner clipping fixes and complete UI state group implementations.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Edit `quiz-page.css` and `variant-quiz-figma.css` to remove modal/iframe constraints, inner scroll rules, and height clamping; switch to natural page flow.
2. Adjust `variant-quiz.js` and `variant-a/index.html` wrapper structure to bypass modal launch behavior while preserving the quiz advancement logic.
3. Implement complete state groups (rest, hover, focus, active) for `.score-button`, links, and option cards per `states.md` order.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720`/`1024x540`, test locally on port `8150`.

## Relevant Files
- `ongoing_project/MTD/variant-a/index.html`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-page.css`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz-figma.css`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/variant-quiz.js`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/mtd-income-tax/quiz-modal.js`
- `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js`
- `skills/shared/states.md`
- `skills/ROUTE.md`
Continue if you have next steps, or stop and ask for clarification if you are unsure how to proceed.

A mounted art is only "as created" if the pane gives it the width it was drawn at — the kit's 58.33% media slot (568 of a 994 pane) ran the tax summary on its three-column rung while its card shows five, so the pane sizes the art to ONE box (max 640, min 360, 500 tall) and the copy takes the remainder at a measured floor (292: at 290 the body cuts "built-in"); a 500-tall frame is not a 500-tall picture — the guide's own air inside it leaves the art at 417/460 and three tabs read smaller than the other two, so the air is zeroed and the art drawn at the box; and a box narrower than an art's mount air (Cleanup's 612 + 24/24 = 660.1) fires that art's rung and lets the dialog cover a radio, so that one pane keeps its column and draws a 640 stage inside it.

Product UI as HTML whose SVG 403s: the shipped `@2x` raster is then the measure source, and its edges are a downscale blend — size type off the measured cap height, never an assumed em ratio (0.72 read the whole small-text ramp a size small), and report the interior agreement rather than chasing its outermost 1px.

Product UI as HTML from a supplied screenshot: the bitmap's black or grey matte is capture surface, not product UI — take the art bounds from the window edges, derive the floor from the narrowest label's ink run and its browser width at 1px (a 2× cap-height read includes descenders and sizes the whole ramp too large), and put the page's backdrop behind the windows rather than repainting the matte. At the smallest rung the rows must feed ONE grid (a per-row `max-content` label track steps every value sideways), the divider belongs to the fieldset's right edge rather than the window's, and the 360 floor's body air leaves at ≤375 — otherwise the scroller engages at 360 itself. A two-window picture keeps both windows as two overlaid surfaces at a phone width — the front right-flush over the back, both front edges right of the back's, never one flow column or one merged surface — and the back window keeps its source width ratio and its FULL body — only its WIDTH scales with the art: its copy, its controls and its body length keep the source's own size at every width, the same absolute type the dialog is frozen at, so its header drops its " - Select Record Type" suffix (a declared rung at a 440px stage, where the full string needs 423) instead of wrapping or shrinking, and the dialog's top edge sits at one fixed offset because nothing above it moves (a scaled glyph put the radios on 6.99px; freezing the type while the box shrinks makes a wide title strip with a giant title, not the same window; shrinking the type to the floor makes a 10px title under a 15.49px one; scaling the HEIGHT makes a shorter window, and the scale here is the horizontal space only); hiding its radios is the wrong rung. A balance row keeps the source's shape — label on the left, both numbers beside it on the `Balance:` line — because putting the label above its numbers wraps a value the source never wraps.

A product-UI variant of a shipped art (a second composition, a 10px floor, a scale) is the frame's arithmetic, and a screenshot cannot show it: run `node tooling/floor-check.js` — canvas 500, smallest type, one card gutter, the table's seat on its footer, the chart's clearance, the composition, at 29 widths in both switch states. Product UI as an animation: a piece that already exists as component HTML/CSS fills no raster slots — copy it verbatim and carry the page bundle's faces, line-height and box-sizing, or the art renders 7.4px short with fallback glyphs.

Page chrome: the same symptom on two pages, or a bug only on the deployed page, is not a folder edit. Run `node tooling/audit-live-comments.js` first. ## Objective
- Refactor the MTD quiz prototype from a modal/iframe container to full-screen native page scrolling, fixing banner clipping at `1280x720` and `1024x540`, and aligning link/button/card UI states with the reference site.

## Important Details
- Prototype is auto-generated by `ongoing_project/MTD/build-variants.js` from `mtd-income-tax/index.html`.
- Strictly no inner scroll container; layout must rely on viewport-level scrolling.
- State handling rule (`skills/shared/states.md`): define rest, hover, focus-visible/pressed, and active states together per shared class before editing.
- Visual/state reference: `https://assets.dev-sageimagine.com/solution-finder/dist/accounting/en-CA/index.html`.
- Constraints: minimal diff, no debug code, do not commit, test locally via `python3 -m http.server 8150`.
- Quiz bundle is minified/byte-frozen; CSS selectors must target existing stable class tokens.
- Workflow governed by `skills/ROUTE.md`; `~/.agents/bin/start-card.py` returned a 404 but is not required for local edits.

## Work State

- Verified routing rules in `skills/ROUTE.md` and state sequencing in `skills/shared/states.md`.
- Scanned `ongoing_project/MTD/` directory structure to locate variants, assets, and build scripts.

### Active

- Planning banner clipping fixes and complete UI state group implementations.

3. Implement complete state groups (rest, hover, focus, active) for `.score-button`, links, and option cards per `states.md` order.
4. Verify layout at `1280x720`/`1024x540`, test locally on port `8150`.
